headline: Nvidia shuts out Huang and drops China sales as Anthropic's IPO nears
bottomLine: Nvidia's board rejected Huang's return and the interim CEO said it is done selling chips to China, while Anthropic was due to price its IPO. In the portfolio, SpaceX caught a Starship upper stage and xAI's Southaven site had a chemical spill.

portfolio.title: SpaceX catches a Starship upper stage for the first time on Flight 15
portfolio.brief: On Flight 15 SpaceX caught Starship's upper stage, a first; a booster malfunction ended a planned double catch attempt.
portfolio.impact: Catching the ship is the step toward reusing it, which cuts cost per flight and raises Starship cadence for Starlink and lunar work. Wells Fargo sees a faster path to full reusability.
portfolio.action: Ask the fund's trading lead whether the first planned SPCX sale ran before the early-November window, and set the next sale timing this week while the catch supports the stock.
